lyrics: The balance sheet, it tells a tale,
When sickness spreads, it doesn't fail,
a lasting pain,   a market steady,
For every pill,   for every grain,
find their fortunes   in the dark,
food you eat, the drugs you take,
cures they seek, no   final ease,
The body breaks, the   spirit tires,
from farm to fork.   The lines
A hidden cost, a   silent work.
find their fortunes   in the dark,
